premise: DepMap is this library's reference application and had only ever been scored as one pool, which answers 'what is broadly essential' - the question whose top is 60% pan-essential. Model.csv carries three nested levels of subgroup and none had been read.

method.effect: Cohen's d of mean Chronos dependency, subgroup against all others
method.test: Welch t, Benjamini-Hochberg within each subgroup
method.stage3: pan-essential genes dropped BEFORE ranking, using DepMap's control set
method.orientation: load_matrix returns a SIGN-FLIPPED matrix (larger = more dependent) and exposes .flipped to say so. The first two runs of this file ignored that field and ranked the anti-dependency, returning SOX10 for Skin at a mean of 1.261 and reading it as 'not a hit' - when that is the single most canonical lineage dependency in the dataset. The orientation is now read from .flipped and the run aborts if it changes.
method.stage0: A hit must be selective AND an actual dependency: mean dependency in the subgroup at or above 0.5. Without this the ranking is also satisfied by the REST being the dependent ones while the subgroup is merely neutral.
method.positiveControls: Textbook lineage dependencies checked on every run, reported with their rank or null: Bowel->CTNNB1/TCF7L2, CNS/Brain->SOX2, Lymphoid->IRF4/POU2AF1, Peripheral Nervous System->MYCN/PHOX2B, Skin->SOX10/MITF
method.stage2: sieve.stages.power reports the smallest effect each subgroup could detect; an underpowered subgroup with no hits is reported as underpowered, never as negative
method.notStage1: This is a difference in means, not a max-order statistic, so it is NOT null-calibrated. docs/lineage.md §9 records that distinction being got wrong once, when the NF2 subgroup contrast ran through a two-null z-difference and the positive control failed.

gates.says: `hits` is the shortlist at the REGISTERED gates (manifests/thresholds.yaml, ADR 0006). `candidates` is every gene clearing a deliberately loose pre-gate, so a reader can move the thresholds and watch the shortlist change. Moving them is target contact - the reader has seen the data - and the interface says so rather than presenting a re-gated list as if it were the registered one.
